_comment: Red-flag rules for score.py. PLACEHOLDER weights by Peter; Mia replaces these with her rules (Gold Coast criteria + ReferALS). Edit numbers and wording here, no code changes needed. 'when' is the finding's value that earns the points (true or false).

rules.why: Numbness or tingling points to a nerve or root problem instead
Up-going plantar or Hoffmann sign (upper motor neuron sign)
Sensory nerves test normal despite weakness

spread_why: Weakness has spread to a second region
umn_plus_lmn_why: Upper and lower motor neuron signs together
_gold_coast: Risk is 'high' whatever the points if: UMN sign (brisk reflexes / up-going plantar / Hoffmann) AND LMN sign (wasting / fasciculations) AND getting worse (spread or failed local treatment).

advice.high: Urgent referral to neurology (ALS / motor neuron disease clinic) recommended. Ask for EMG if not done. Do not wait for more local treatment trials.
advice.medium: Possible early pattern. Re-examine in 4 to 6 weeks; refer to neurology if weakness spreads, wasting appears, or treatment does not help.
advice.low: No ALS red-flag pattern in these notes.
